name: Premium Blade Flags
descriptionHtml:
Command attention from afar with our Premium Blade Flags, designed for maximum height, visibility, and brand impact at trade shows, outdoor events, storefronts, festivals, and large-scale promotions. The tall blade-style shape delivers a sleek, vertical presentation that stands out even in crowded environments.

Available in 11ft, 16ft, and 21ft sizes, all blade flags are double-sided by default, ensuring your branding is visible from both directions. Your artwork is printed using high-resolution full-color dye sublimation on premium knitted polyester fabric for bold colors and long-lasting durability.

Each flag comes standard with a cross base and water bag, making it suitable for indoor and outdoor use. For added versatility, you may upgrade to ground stakes or a canopy mounting kit, allowing the flag to be securely mounted directly to a canopy tent.

Constructed with strong yet flexible fiberglass poles, these flags are lightweight, durable, and easy to assemble—perfect for vendors who need height, stability, and professional presentation.

🔹 Key Features

🚩 Blade Flag Design – Tall, vertical shape for long-distance visibility
📏 Available Sizes – 11ft, 16ft, and 21ft
🔁 Double-Sided Printing Included – Standard on all flags
🎨 Full-Color Dye Sublimation – Sharp, fade-resistant graphics
💪 Fiberglass Poles – Lightweight, flexible, and durable
⚓ Base Included – Cross base + water bag included
🏕️ Multiple Mounting Options – Optional ground stakes or canopy mounting kit
🧳 Portable & Easy Setup – Ideal for large events and promotions

🔹 Imprint Method

🖨️ Full-Color Dye Sublimation

🔹 Materials

🧵 Graphic / Flag: Knitted Polyester
🦾 Hardware: 100% Epoxy Fiberglass
🎒 Carry Case: 600 Denier Polyester

🔹 Primary Usage

Trade shows, outdoor events, vendor booths, canopy tents, storefront advertising, festivals, promotions, and brand activations.

Warranty

We stand behind the quality of our products. Our warranty covers any factory defects or damage that occurs during shipping. However, please note that we do not cover damage resulting from extreme weather conditions, misuse, or any circumstances beyond our control.
